question: If the speed of a boat in still water is 3 km/h and if its speed upstream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the stream.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of stream** = **Still water speed** − **Upstream speed**

Speed of stream = 3 km/h − 1 km/h

Speed of stream = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in **still water** (u) = 3 km/h

Speed of boat **upstream** (vᵤ) = 1 km/h

**Formula used:**

**Upstream speed** (vᵤ) = **Still water speed** (u) − **Stream speed** (v)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a66e290651b50ddfaa38efb20da7b777601fbba0f12c34dc35eae42174db80.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Upstream speed = Still water speed − Stream speed

⇒ 1 km/h = 3 km/h − Stream speed

⇒ Stream speed = 3 km/h − 1 km/h

⇒ Stream speed = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

It is the net speed of a boat moving with the flow of the stream. **Downstream Speed = Speed in still water + Speed of stream.**

Speed in Still Water

The actual speed of the boat without any stream influence. **Still Water Speed = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2.**

Speed of the Stream

The speed at which the water is flowing. **Stream Speed = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2.**</p
